Just Say It

Get started

  1. Open the DMG and drag SayKuku into Applications.
  2. Launch the app and grant microphone and Accessibility permissions.
  3. Add your own Alibaba Cloud Model Studio API key. Voice requests are processed in the cloud; model calls may incur charges.
